productBrief:
Feature: Team Expense Tracker — Internal API PRD
The Finance team requires a lightweight internal REST API that allows employees to log business expenses and enables managers and admins to review, approve, and report on those expenses. Today there is no structured system, which makes monthly consolidation manual and error-prone. The proposed solution is a FastAPI + PostgreSQL service exposing role-scoped endpoints for three actor types: **employees** (submit and edit their own expenses), **managers** (view monthly aggregations per team), and **admins** (manage teams and action approval workflow).
